def _create_pending_order(event, code, expires, **kwargs):
    return Order.objects.create(
        code=code, event=event, email='dummy@example.org',
        status=Order.STATUS_PENDING, locale='en',
        datetime=now() - timedelta(days=10),
        expires=expires,
        total=Decimal('23.00'),
        sales_channel=event.organizer.sales_channels.get(identifier="web"),
        **kwargs
    )


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expire_orders_expires_overdue_pending_order(event):
    order = _create_pending_order(event, 'OVERDUE', now() - timedelta(days=1))
    expire_orders(sender=None)
    order.refresh_from_db()
    assert order.status == Order.STATUS_EXPIRED
    assert order.all_logentries().filter(action_type='pretix.event.order.expired').exists()


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expire_orders_keeps_order_not_yet_due(event):
    order = _create_pending_order(event, 'FUTURE', now() + timedelta(days=1))
    expire_orders(sender=None)
    order.refresh_from_db()
    assert order.status == Order.STATUS_PENDING


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expire_orders_respects_disabled_setting(event):
    event.settings.set('payment_term_expire_automatically', False)
    order = _create_pending_order(event, 'DISABLED', now() - timedelta(days=1))
    expire_orders(sender=None)
    order.refresh_from_db()
    assert order.status == Order.STATUS_PENDING


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expire_orders_respects_expiration_delay(event):
    event.settings.set('payment_term_expire_automatically', True)
    event.settings.set('payment_term_expire_delay_days', 3)
    not_yet = _create_pending_order(event, 'DELAYED', now() - timedelta(days=1))
    due = _create_pending_order(event, 'DELAYOVER', now() - timedelta(days=5))

    expire_orders(sender=None)
    not_yet.refresh_from_db()
    due.refresh_from_db()
    assert not_yet.status == Order.STATUS_PENDING
    assert due.status == Order.STATUS_EXPIRED


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expire_orders_skips_paid_order(event):
    order = _create_pending_order(event, 'PAID', now() - timedelta(days=1), status=Order.STATUS_PAID)
    expire_orders(sender=None)
    order.refresh_from_db()
    assert order.status == Order.STATUS_PAID


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expire_orders_skips_valid_if_pending(event):
    order = _create_pending_order(event, 'VALIDPENDING', now() - timedelta(days=1), valid_if_pending=True)
    expire_orders(sender=None)
    order.refresh_from_db()
    assert order.status == Order.STATUS_PENDING


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expire_orders_skips_order_requiring_approval(event):
    order = _create_pending_order(event, 'APPROVAL', now() - timedelta(days=1), require_approval=True)
    expire_orders(sender=None)
    order.refresh_from_db()
    assert order.status == Order.STATUS_PENDING


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expire_orders_skips_open_cancellation_fee(event):
    order = _create_pending_order(event, 'CANCELFEE', now() - timedelta(days=1))
    OrderFee.objects.create(order=order, fee_type=OrderFee.FEE_TYPE_CANCELLATION, value=Decimal('5.00'))
    expire_orders(sender=None)
    order.refresh_from_db()
    assert order.status == Order.STATUS_PENDING
EOF
